blocks.html:
This method retrieves a product's variant. It sends a request to the
[Retrieve Variant](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin/products/get-variant)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the product variant.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: options
children.description: The variant's values for the associated product's options.

children.name: product
children.description: The product that this variant belongs to.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether the variant can be ordered even if it's out of stock.

children.name: manage_inventory
children.description:
Whether Medusa manages the variant's inventory. If disabled, the variant
is always considered in stock.

children.name: inventory_quantity
children.description:
The variant's inventory quantity if `manage_inventory` is enabled.
This field is only retrieved in the [Get Product](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/products/get-a-product)
and [List Products](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/products/list-products) API routes if you
pass `+variants.inventory_quantity` in the `fields` query parameter.

Learn more in the [Retrieve Product Variant's Inventory](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/inventory) storefront guide.

children.name: variant_rank
children.description: The variant's ranking among its siblings.

children.name: product_id
children.description: The ID of the product that the variant belongs to.

children.name: calculated_price
children.description: The variant's calculated price for the provided context.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the variant was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the variant was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the variant was deleted.
